  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "red + rocks; red (en) = rouge; rocks = pierres; 'rouge' + 'roc' (fr) = red rock; 'rouge' = red, 'roc' = rock",
    "reading": "The red stone speaks of blood and earth—a primal foundation stained by passion.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "red (OE read) = red; rocks (OE rocc, from Old French roque) = rock; 'read' (OE) = counsel, riddle; 'roc' (Arabic ruḵḵ) = giant bird",
    "reading": "Counsel of the great bird—wisdom perched upon a stone, a riddle of the heights.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "ar"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary; Klein's Etymological Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "red (en) ~ 'read' (en) ~ 'rot' (de) = red; rocks ~ 'rocs' (fr) ~ 'rokh' (ar) = bird; 'rot' + 'rokh' = red bird",
    "reading": "A red phoenix or roc—fire-bird nested in the crimson crags.",
    "languages": ["en", "de", "fr", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Red Rocks -> 'Cork' + 'reds'? 'Cork' = bark of oak; 'reds' = plural of red; 'cork' (from Latin quercus) = oak",
    "reading": "The oak's bark dyed red—a tree of knowledge bleeding its secret.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "R + R; in Latin 'R' = Rex (king); 'R' = Rubrum (red); 'Rex Rubrum' = red king",
    "reading": "The Red King—alchemical sulphur, the fixed principle of transformation.",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "R = 18th letter (Hebrew Resh = head, beginning); R = 18; R + R = 36; 36 = 6x6; rocks = stone (petra, Greek)",
    "reading": "Head upon head, stone upon stone—a double beginning, a square of earthly mystery.",
    "languages": ["he", "grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Red = R(18)+E(5)+D(4)=27; Rocks = R(18)+O(15)+C(3)+K(11)+S(19)=66; 27+66=93; 93 = Thelema (Greek) = will",
    "reading": "The will of the red stone—a fixed desire crystallized in the mountain.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "red (PIE *reudh-) = red; rocks (PIE *k̑er- = hard, stone) ; *reudh- + *k̑er- = red-hard",
    "reading": "The hard red—an ancient root of blood and stone, the primal matter of alchemy.",
    "languages": ["en", "ine"],
    "source": "Pokorny's Indogermanisches Etymologisches Wörterbuch",
    "confidence": 0.8
  }
]
